entity_id.description: Entity Id: Pattern(error = INVALID_ENTITY_ID: Invalid entity id. Only numbers are allowed., regexp = [0-9]+$)

name.description: Name: NotEmpty(EXTENSION_NAME_REQD) Size(max = 128, error = INVALID_EXTENSION_NAME: Invalid Extension name., min = 0)

namespace.description: Namespace: NotEmpty(EXTENSION_NAMESPACE_REQD) Pattern(error = INVALID_EXTENSION_NAMESPACE: Invalid Namespace. Allowed characters are a-z0-9/ and it should start with alphabet., regexp = ^[a-z][a-z0-9/]*[a-z0-9]+$)
